info.name: Infosys Platform - Comprehensive CRUD & Regression Suite
info.description: Comprehensive Postman test collection for the Organizational Knowledge Gap Intelligence Platform (Spring Boot & MySQL). Contains 124 REST endpoints categorized into 21 modules, with end-to-end sequential CRUD lifecycles (C -> R -> U -> R -> D -> R), negative/edge-case tests, dynamic ID extraction, and automated assertions.
